prompt:
Create a contemporary, polished desktop homepage UI mockup for FoodBridge at 1536×1024, edge-to-edge real website screenshot with crisp legible interface text, no device or browser frame. FoodBridge coordinates food sharing and separate waste collection in Sri Lanka. Preserve its name. All five roles must be equally discoverable: Donor, Recipient, Recycler, Volunteer, Admin. Recipients and recyclers can register for review; browsing and claims are not available yet. Admins sign in, never publicly register. Never invent metrics, live activity, endorsements, testimonials, maps, certifications, or deployed capabilities.

Visual direction: contemporary digital product with a photographic editorial sensibility. Bright white space, near-black evergreen typography, fresh pale green support and a controlled vivid lime accent. Precise modern sans-serif typography with a confident display scale and quieter regular-weight body copy. Generous margins, refined alignment, subtle borders, compact controls, and softly rounded photographic crops. Avoid the dated institutional look: NO road signs, numbered destinations, giant pictograms, thick green stripes, directory tables, glossy gradients, ornamental blobs, drop-shadow stacks, or repetitive role cards.
Composition B is bold typography-led with product photography integrated into the open page canvas. A minimal white masthead carries FoodBridge, "How it works", "Community impact", and "Sign in". The oversized but refined headline "More shared. Less wasted." is the focal point, using confident modern sans typography with controlled line lengths, not a chunky road-sign face. Introduce "Food sharing and waste collection in Sri Lanka." in much smaller regular text. A beautifully lit photographic cutout of a reusable crate with fresh vegetables and two hands passing it occupies the lower central page, partially crossing the headline's negative space; it has real photographic texture and a clean white ground, not clip art or 3D cartoon styling. Keep copy legible and preserve deliberate empty space.

Along the lower edge of the opening composition, integrate one elegant horizontal role switcher: "Donor", "Recipient", "Recycler", "Volunteer", "Admin", with equal visual weight, plus an obvious "Choose your role" action. It feels like a contemporary product onboarding control, never five cards or a table. Add the readable notes "Admin access requires sign-in." and "Recipient and recycler browsing and claims are not available yet." A distinct pale-green section begins below: "Food shared. Waste collected separately." with a small "View community impact" link. Prioritise clean typography, useful action, and strong photographic art direction over decoration.
